spans.s: प्रुष्, i. 1, Par. (i. e. probably प्र-उष्), To burn, to consume by fire. ii. 9 (i. e. probably प्र-उक्ष्), प्रुष्णा, प्रुष्णि,

. To sprinkle.
 2. † To be wet.
 3. † To fill.
 --Cf. perhaps περι-ϕλύω.

प्रुष् + व,
 I. m.
 1. The rainy season.
 2. The sun.
 II. f. वा, A drop of water.
प्रुष्वाय, a denomin. derived from प्रुष्वा with य, Ātm. To dribble.
